recommendedOpportunity.description: Choose a course from the following options. Please note that you are required to take at least 30 elective credits at some point in your degree. Please consult an advisor or refer to the AAS-DTA degree worksheet to learn about additional course options.

recommendedOpportunity.name: Choose a course
recommendedOpportunity.description:
For Natural Sciences, you will need to select courses from two different subjects. The following list includes courses that were selected by faculty and advisors in this area. You can choose a course from this list or you can choose a course from the complete list of Natural Sciences courses found on the AAS-DTA degree worksheet. Please consult an advisor or refer to the AAS-DTA degree worksheet to learn about additional course options. 

Please note that one of these courses must be a lab science (6 credits).

recommendedOpportunity.title: Meet with Academic Advisor
recommendedOpportunity.shortDescription: Set up an appointment this quarter
recommendedOpportunity.longDescription: It is important to set up an education plan that is specific to your goals. Every university and major will require slightly different prerequisites. It is highly recommended that you speak with a BC academic advisor to ensure you are meeting program, degree, and university transfer requirements.

recommendedOpportunity.name: Choose a course
recommendedOpportunity.description:
For Social Sciences, you will need to select courses from two different subjects. The following list includes courses that were selected by faculty and advisors in this area. You can choose a course from this list or you can choose a course from the complete list of Social Sciences courses found on the AAS-DTA degree worksheet. Please consult an advisor or refer to the AAS-DTA degree worksheet to learn about additional course options. 
Please note that you must take one course in either Social Sciences, Humanities, or Electives that fulfills the Diversity Degree Requirement (DDR) at some point in your degree. ANTH 222, SOC& 101, SOC 262, and PHIL 102 will fulfill the DDR requirement.
